# Magic

Laravel-inspired Flutter framework: IoC container, facades, Eloquent-style API-first ORM, service providers, routing, auth, validation. UI is `wind_kit` on `material_ui`; CLI and scaffolding run on `dowel`. SQLite, broadcasting, encryption and the file picker are plugins (`magic_local_storage`, `magic_socket`, `magic_encryption`, `magic_picker`): `flutter pub add <pkg>` then `dart run magic:dowel plugin:install <pkg>`.

**Stack:** Dart >=3.13.0, Flutter >=3.47.0. Runtime deps: `wind_kit`, `material_ui`, `dowel`, `dio`, `go_router`, `flutter_secure_storage`, `flutter_dotenv`, `intl`, `jiffy`. No `mockito` (mock via contract inheritance), no code generation.
**Branch:** `master` is the development line; the next tag publishes it. Direct pushes are blocked, everything lands through a PR. Semver from 1.0.0: a breaking change needs a major version.

The dev-tooling adapters live in the sibling `magic_devtools` package; core has zero dependency on tapir or crumbs. LLM-agent surface: `skills/magic-framework/SKILL.md`. Consumer overview: `README.md`.

## The example app

`example/` is the in-repo smoke reference: it pins `magic: {path: .., version: ...}` (the `version` key is a release stamp), builds in CI, is regenerated per release by `magic:install` and shows on pub.dev's example tab. It declares only `magic`, `dowel` and `material_ui`. It cannot take a hosted plugin: **pub refuses to unify path and hosted dependencies in one resolution graph**, so a hosted `magic_*` plugin beside `magic: {path: ..}` fails with "magic_x depends on magic from hosted and example depends on magic from path". A real app starts from `flutter create` plus `magic:install`, then adds `magic_starter` and the plugins it needs as hosted dependencies.

## Post-Change Checklist (every code change under `lib/`)

Done in the same change set, before reporting:

1. **`CHANGELOG.md`**: an entry under `## [Unreleased]` (BREAKING / Added / Changed / Removed / Fixed / Improvements).
2. **`doc/`**: update the matching page (a facade or API change: `doc/architecture/facades.md` and the page of its subsystem; a changed behaviour: its Gotchas row too), verify every documented method exists in the source, keep ToC entries and `<a name>` anchors consistent. A caller-visible change is flagged BREAKING in the CHANGELOG. Authoring guide: `doc/contributing/documentation.md`; the full surface-to-docs table and formats: `.claude/rules/docs.md` (loads when you open a doc file).
3. **`README.md`** and **`llms.txt`**: when the change is overview-worthy (new facade, public API, top-level feature), and one `llms.txt` line for every new doc page.
4. **`skills/magic-framework/`**: `SKILL.md` and the matching `references/<topic>.md` when facades, APIs or patterns change; bump the `version:` line. The registry mirror (`anilcancakir/ai`) rides the release: `publish.yml` calls `dispatch-to-registry.yml` after its `github-release` job. A skill fix that cannot wait gets a manual `gh workflow run dispatch-to-registry.yml`.
5. **`example/`**: update or add usage for changed or new features.
6. **Scaffolding**: a change to facade APIs, config domains, base classes or core providers also touches the `make:*` stubs under `assets/stubs/` and `install.yaml`.

## Development Flow

TDD, red-green-refactor: a failing test first (it must fail for the right reason), the minimum code to pass, then refactor. A change is done when `flutter analyze` reports nothing on the touched files, `dart format .` produces no diff and `flutter test` is green (pre-existing skips noted, never new). `python3 tool/check-docs.py` reports 0 issues when `doc/` changed. `flutter pub publish --dry-run` is clean before any release.

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `flutter test --coverage` | All tests, plus `coverage/lcov.info` (CI uploads it to Codecov) |
| `flutter test test/<module>` | One module |
| `flutter test --tags integration --run-skipped` | Runs every `make:*` generator and analyzes the output (CI job `Generated code analyzes`) |
| `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos` | Static analysis, as CI runs it |
| `dart format .` | Format (CI checks with `--set-exit-if-changed`) |
| `python3 tool/check-docs.py` | Docs page shape, links and fragments |
| `flutter pub publish --dry-run` | Pre-release validation |
| `dart run magic:dowel magic:install` | One-shot consumer bootstrap (hybrid installer) |
| `dart run magic:dowel make:model User -mcf` | Generators (`make:*`) |

Magic ships a `dowel` executable (`pubspec.yaml` `executables: { dowel: }`, backed by `bin/dowel.dart`), so a consumer runs any command with `dart run magic:dowel <cmd>` once `magic` is a dependency, with no global activate. `MagicDowelProvider` supplies the commands; the executable delegates to the consumer's `bin/dispatcher.dart` (scaffolded by `dart run dowel install`) when one exists, so plugin commands resolve. Never run `dart run magic:dowel` inside this repo and never add a `bin/dispatcher.dart` here: dowel would delegate to itself.

## Architecture

**Pattern:** Service Provider + IoC Container + Facade. **Lifecycle:** `Magic.init()`, `Env.load()`, `configFactories`, providers `register()` (sync), providers `boot()` (async), router pre-build, ready. **Resolution:** facades are static stubs delegating to `Magic.make<T>('key')`; no `dart:mirrors`, bindings are string-keyed factory closures.

Opt-in barrels beside `lib/magic.dart` (the public API): `lib/cli.dart` (the Flutter-free dowel provider) and `lib/testing.dart` (test fakes).

```
lib/
├── magic.dart               # Barrel export (public API)
├── config/                  # Default configs (app, auth, cache, filesystems, localization, logging, network, routing, view)
└── src/
    ├── foundation/          # MagicApp (IoC), Magic (bootstrap), ConfigRepository, Env
    ├── facades/             # Auth Cache Config Event Gate Http Lang Launch Log Route Session Storage Vault
    ├── auth/  policies/     # AuthManager, guards (Bearer/Basic/ApiKey), events; Policy
    ├── database/            # eloquent/ base Model, casts, HasTimestamps, InteractsWithPersistence; contracts/ LocalModelStore
    ├── data/                # Repository and RepositoryQuery (row caches)
    ├── actions/  forms/     # MagicAction, RunsActions; MagicFormObject
    ├── http/                # MagicController, middleware pipeline, Kernel
    ├── concerns/            # ValidatesRequests mixin (import from here, NOT http/)
    ├── routing/  launch/    # go_router wrapper, middleware on navigation; Launch adapter
    ├── session/  storage/  cache/  security/  network/  events/
    ├── localization/  logging/  validation/  support/  helpers/  providers/
    ├── perf/                # MagicPerfHooks, the pointers magic_devtools assigns
    ├── ui/  testing/        # MagicView and feedback on wind_kit; fakes behind lib/testing.dart
    └── cli/                 # magic:install and the make:* generators on dowel
```

## Testing

Every `setUp()` calls `MagicApp.reset()` and `Magic.flush()`: they clear the IoC container and the facade caches between tests, and skipping them leaks state into false passes. Mock via contract inheritance (implement the abstract class, or use the `lib/testing.dart` fakes), never mockito. The `test/` tree mirrors `lib/src/`. Full discipline: `.claude/rules/tests.md`.

## Key Gotchas

| Mistake | Fix |
|---------|-----|
| Facade call before `Magic.init()` | `await Magic.init()` in `main()` first |
| Missing `Auth.manager.setUserFactory()` | Set it in `AppServiceProvider.boot()`; session restore fails without it. List AppServiceProvider BEFORE AuthServiceProvider |
| `LaunchServiceProvider` | NOT auto-registered: add it to the `providers` config. Plugin providers are added by `plugin:install` |
| `configFactories` vs `configs` | Use `configFactories` for configs that read `Env.get()` |
| Registering event listeners | `BaseEventServiceProvider.listen` and `Event.listen<T>()` take listener factories (`MagicListener Function()`), not instances |
| `routerConfig` before init | Only accessible after `Magic.init()` completes |
| `ValidatesRequests` import | From `lib/src/concerns/`, not `http/` |
| `useLocal => true` model without `magic_local_storage` | Throws a `StateError` naming the plugin (nothing bound to `'local_model_store'`). SQLite, its web `sqlite3.wasm` and `Model.query()` live in the plugin |
| IO `Storage.download` without `magic_picker` | Throws `UnsupportedError`: the plugin sets `LocalAdapterContract.downloadHandler`. Web is unchanged |
| `MagicResponse.errors` format | Parses Laravel's `{"errors": {"field": ["msg"]}}` |
| Relative paths in `pubspec_overrides.yaml` | Use ABSOLUTE ones. `.worktreeinclude` copies that file into worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/<slug>`, where `../magic_starter` resolves to `.claude/worktrees/magic_starter` and version solving fails on the first path dependency |

## Release

GitHub Flow, one long-lived `master`. Task branches (`feat/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`, `docs/*`) are cut from master and merged back through a PR (merge commit). A release is a `chore(release): X.Y.Z` PR that bumps `pubspec.yaml`, promotes `## [Unreleased]` to `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD` in `CHANGELOG.md`, and syncs the stamps: the `example/pubspec.yaml` `magic` pin and the `<!-- magic X.Y.Z |` line in `skills/magic-framework/SKILL.md` (the skill's own `version:` moves only when skill content moves). After the merge, tag the merge commit on master by SHA, not the checked-out branch tip: `git fetch origin && git tag X.Y.Z <merge-commit-sha> && git push origin X.Y.Z` (bare tag, no `v`). `publish.yml` then refuses a tag that is not on master or whose stamps disagree, runs analyze, format and test, `flutter pub publish --dry-run`, pana (160 points), publishes to pub.dev over OIDC, creates the GitHub Release from the CHANGELOG section and syncs the skill to the registry. The first publish of a new package is manual (`dart pub publish` from a clean checkout of the merge commit), since OIDC cannot create a package. A tag pushed afterwards makes `publish.yml` fail at the already-published version, so the jobs behind it never run: cancel that run, create the GitHub Release from the CHANGELOG section with `gh release create X.Y.Z --verify-tag --notes-file <section>`, and run `gh workflow run dispatch-to-registry.yml --ref X.Y.Z` for the skill; then enable automated publishing on pub.dev (tag pattern `[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+*`).

## CI

- `ci.yml` (push and PR to master): `Lint & Test` (`flutter pub get`, `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos`, `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .`, `flutter test --coverage`, Codecov upload) and `Generated code analyzes`.
- `changelog.yml`: `Changelog` fails a PR that changes `lib/`, `bin/`, `install.yaml` or `assets/stubs/` without a CHANGELOG entry; Dependabot, `release:` titles and the `skip-changelog` label are exempt.
- `docs-link-check.yml`: `Internal Links` (`tool/check-docs.py` plus lychee offline) on every PR; `External Links` weekly.
- `publish.yml` (tag `[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+*`) and `dispatch-to-registry.yml`: see Release.
- Branch protection on `master` requires `Lint & Test`, `Changelog` and `Internal Links`, with conversation resolution.
